articles.title: The Global Economy After the Iran War Ends
articles.snippet: Even if the Iran war ended tomorrow, the global economy would not simply pick up where it left off. Reopening the Strait of Hormuz could bring down commodity prices and ease inflation, but postwar reconstruction could redirect capital away from the United States, undermining the AI supercycle and fueling de-dollarization.
